Samira Khan: Hi team! Samira here, excited to join eng-platform today. Laptop just arrived, trying to enroll — running macOS Monterey on an M1. Any quick MDM tips? Also where's the badge pickup and are stickers still a thing? :wave:

DevEx (Nikhil): welcome Samira!! :tada: For M1/M2, run the profile and then force a recon if JAMF stalls:
```bash
sudo profiles install /opt/redwood/mdm.mobileconfig
sudo jamf recon || echo 'jamf retry'
```
If it shows "pending" for >10m DM me. VPN guide pinned in #devex.

onboard-bot: New hire account provisioned: Samira Khan. Teams: engineers, eng-platform. Onboarding checklist: https://intranet.redwood.com/onboarding/samira_khan. Sticker request queued.

Jules (People Ops): hey Samira  welcome! We left a welcome kit on your desk and mailed one to your home (tracking 1Z333AA10123456901). Badge pickup at security after 1pm; bring ID. Team lunch Friday 12:30 if you can make it.

Felix (Manager): welcome! 1:1 tomorrow 9:30am PT. For your first-week ramp: tiny PR to add an example to infra/health-checks (good intro to our repo layout). Pairing volunteers will help you through CI. Fun fact thread: drop one odd skill so folks break the ice. I'll go first: I can blindfold-proofread (don't ask how). :nerd_face:

Clara Ortiz: hey Samira  I'm your onboarding buddy. Quick pairing today at 2pm PT? I'll send a calendar invite. Also FYI, if you need extra repo access, open a ticket in #access with repo name.

Samira Khan: 2pm PT works great, thanks Clara. Fun fact: I used to be a part-time improv performer, so expect terrible puns. Looking forward to meeting y'all in person.

DevEx (Nikhil): invite dropped for 2pm PT and a short checklist in DM. If the JAMF command fails, paste the last 20 lines of /var/log/jamf.log here and I'll take a look.

Jules (People Ops): badge status updated: ready for pickup after 1pm. See you at lunch if you're free! :salute:
